ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering the Extent of the Feeding Our Future Fraud Scheme
ideas.description: This story would investigate the Feeding Our Future fraud scheme and uncover the extent of the corruption and lack of accountability in government and private organizations
questions: What was the extent of the Feeding Our Future fraud scheme?
Who was involved in the scheme?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover a large-scale fraud scheme and hold those responsible accountable. It requires careful investigation and analysis of financial records and other evidence.
